entries.what: A check that cannot see a thing cannot protect it
entries.detail: The operator-view guard read 82 pages and never opened an archive header, so 27 reverts passed clean. Its scope now derives <market>-archive.html from the same market set: 82 → 109.

entries.what: A string caught three times by inference
entries.detail: The Day 3/10/30 cadence arrived with a stale copy three times and was caught only by validator and guard counts. gate.py STOP 5 (exit 6) now names it on every market, expansion and archive page.
A published figure carries its definition on the same line, or it does not appear. Striking a number nobody can reproduce is the correct outcome, not a loss.
